# 32rogues by Seth (sethbb)

Source: https://sethbb.itch.io/32rogues
License: free for commercial & non-commercial use (no NFT/blockchain/generative-AI use,
no redistribution/resale of the raw pack). Credit not required, appreciated. See LICENSE.txt.

Files used (copied to public/assets/):
- tiles.png -> 32r-tiles.png (walls, floors, chest, barrel, bones, sarcophagus)
- rogues.png -> 32r-rogues.png (hero: knight)
- monsters.png -> 32r-monsters.png (enemies: goblin, skeleton)
- items.png -> 32r-items.png (potions)

The 0x72 DungeonTilesetII pack (see ../0x72-dungeon-tileset-ii/) is still used for the
procedurally-animated torch and the HUD heart icons.
